news.detail: Boswell pushed a 57-yard field-goal attempt wide left in the first quarter before later converting a 56-yarder as time expired in the first half. The kicker has now gone 3-for-5 on field-goal tries, including 1-for-3 from 50-plus yards, over two contests to open the 2026 campaign.
